Verbatim excerpt of RxNorm Current Prescribable Content, release 2026-09-08
(`RxNorm_full_prescribe_09082026.zip`, MD5 88bbe4cefabd8e71f58651c1c3188646), from the
U.S. National Library of Medicine. Public domain; see DATA-LICENSES.md.

Rows were selected, not edited: all RXNORM atoms (and MTHSPL SU atoms) for a fixed set of
RXCUIs, RXNORM relationships among them, their RXNORM attributes, and a few MTHSPL rows that
the importer must ignore. Regenerate with `scripts/make-fixture.sh`.
